statistics.quality: audited equal-split means and 95% hierarchical bootstrap intervals; complete trajectories; missing split remains N/A
statistics.time: median complete-trajectory elapsed seconds; shared preparation excluded
statistics.tokens: median reported total tokens of complete trajectories; all generation attempts included
statistics.speed: sum of reported output_tokens divided by sum of generationSeconds within each complete trajectory, then group median; reasoning/waiting included; not decoding-only throughput
statistics.completion: completed trajectories / all planned trajectories; failures remain in denominator
